title: Cyrax321/CONTINUUM
summary: CONTINUUM是一个用于长期运行AI代理的可验证语义恢复框架。它提供了语义检查点、幂等动作账本和防篡改事件日志，并通过默认拒绝访问的MCP服务器暴露。该框架不依赖于特定框架，支持Python 3.11及以上版本，适用于需要稳定性和可恢复性的AI代理应用。，基于模型推理的架构
description: CONTINUUM: Verifiable semantic recovery for long-running AI agents. Semantic checkpoints (not conversation dumps), an idempotent action ledger that refuses duplicate side effects, and a hash-chained tamper-evident event log, all exposed as a deny-by-default MCP server. Framework-agnostic, Python 3.1
